checks.detail: Within this loop's slice scope no product defect was found. Runtime: both host receipts (hash-verified by Tester) show fresh npm+cargo builds (exit 0), a real 'Focusboard' native window with tauri: renderer, product-UI separation, embedded assets, unchanged source/binary. Interface: baseline screenshot shows the PRD 9.1 auth shell (editorial canvas, restrained amber accent, sign-in visually primary, no prohibited patterns); the replay drove an invalid-email submit and captured the rendered validation message with inputs preserved. Persistence/security: independently re-verified by the Tester on a disposable staging of this exact candidate tree (cargo 1.90.0, warm-target build): cargo test 3/3 covering register -> mail-sink verify -> sign-in -> quick-add -> full-store-reopen persistence, single-use expiring tokens, unverified sign-in rejection, empty-title rejection, generic rate-limited failures, private-operation gating, cross-user isolation; source review confirms Argon2 hashing, SHA-256-hashed session/email tokens with expiry and revocation, server-side require_user gate on every private command, user_id-scoped SQL, CSP configured, empty capabilities (least privilege), credential-free local mail sink. Remaining gaps are evidence-side (GUI-level first-run drive, signed-in view captures) and are filed as minor findings, not product failures.
